name: Ample and Nonample Daisy Obstructions
statement: A forbidden pc-minor for daisy cubes is nonample exactly when it is an antipodally punctured hypercube $Q_n^{--}$ for some $n\ge3$. Every obstruction in the peripheral coordinate normal form is ample.
proof: The $Q_n^{--}$ are precisely the forbidden pc-minors for ampleness. If a daisy obstruction were nonample, it would contain some $Q_n^{--}$ as a pc-minor; since that minor is itself nondaisy, pc-minimality forces equality with the whole obstruction. All remaining members of the complete daisy basis are therefore ample.
